jobs.description: Typix est une solution SaaS de rédaction assistée par intelligence artificielle, développée par Pixalione. Pixalione est une agence leader en France sur les sujets SEO, SEA, Data, UX/CRO et IA, fondée en 2007, reconnue pour son approche scientifique, data-driven et orientée performance. Quelques repères sur Pixalione : 19 ans d’expertise en Search Marketing Plus de 70 collaborateurs Présence en France (Paris, Lille, Lyon, Bordeaux, Toulouse) et à l’international Un pôle R&D avancé, en partenariat avec des universités et laboratoires de recherche Développement de solutions propriétaires data, SEO et IA Références grands comptes, ETI et scale-ups Typix est né de cette expertise terrain et R&D, avec une ambition claire : industrialiser la production de contenus SEO performants grâce à l’IA, tout en garantissant qualité, pertinence métier et performance business. Nous recrutons un Account Executive / Commercial – France pour porter la croissance de Typix sur le marché français. Aussi, tu seras le référent business France, au cœur du développement commercial, en lien direct avec la direction de Pixalione et les équipes produit. Dans ce contexte tes missions principales seront les suivantes : Prospection active outbound et inbound Qualification des leads Démonstrations produit Closing des deals Upsell et cross-sell Construction du pipe commercial France Mise en place des process de vente Contribution au positionnement marché Feedback produit vers les équipes tech et R&D Participation à la stratégie pricing et packaging Participation aux événements SEO, marketing et IA Nous recherchons une personne diplômée d’un BAC + 5 école de commerce, avec des expériences ou une appétence forte dans le domaine de la tech et qui souhaite évoluer dans un environnement en forte croissance. Ce que nous t’offrons chez Pixalione ! Une équipe ambitieuse, bienveillante et passionnée ; Des projets variés, challengers et à forte valeur ajoutée ; Un environnement où ton expertise est valorisée ;

jobs.description: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com. We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. We are looking for our first dedicated Senior Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs and payment flows. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks. What you will do: Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows. Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction. Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners. Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting). Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively. jobs.title: AI Solution Engineer
jobs.description: Wir sind Royal Runtimes. Wir bauen AI-Systeme, bevor andere darüber Folien machen. Wir sind ein kleines AI-Studio in Hamburg. Wir beraten Unternehmen zu AI und bauen dabei genau die Dinge, die wir selbst jeden Tag benutzen. Manche davon werden zu eigenen Produkten, die wir mit Partnern als Joint Ventures launchen. Andere bauen wir nur für uns, weil wir sie brauchen. Mit wem du arbeitest Henning hat bei Tchibo als Head of AI Engineering & Platform die AI-Transformation vorangetrieben. Mit GPT-1 hat er schon unlustige Witze-Bots gebaut, als noch niemand Sprachmodelle kannte. Als studierter Statistiker hat er sogar manchmal Ahnung, wovon er redet. Erik hat Consulting einmal komplett durchgespielt, zuletzt als Business Unit Manager Data & AI bei Reply Enterprise Consulting. Im früheren Leben war er Data Scientist, Python-Enthusiast, ML-Evangelist, Contributor bei Apache Spark und MLflow, blahblahblah. Du bist unsere erste Einstellung und arbeitest vom ersten Tag an direkt mit uns beiden. Wir werden kontinuierlich wachsen. Du lernst viel von uns, und wir wollen auch von dir lernen: die neue Harness, die du am Wochenende getestet hast, den Hack, der einen Skill doppelt so gut macht. Was du bei uns machst Du baust AI-Systeme für unsere Kunden: Agenten, AI-Plattformen, Software Factories. Von der Architektur bis zum Betrieb. Du arbeitest an Strategieprojekten mit, in denen Unternehmen zu Builder Companies werden. Du arbeitest agentisch. Coding Agents sind bei uns das Standardwerkzeug für fast alles. Du probierst aus, was im AI-Umfeld neu erscheint, und bringst das Brauchbare in unsere Projekte. Du übernimmst Verantwortung in unseren eigenen Produkten und Ventures. Was du mitbringst AI ist dein Beruf und dein Hobby, und das schon seit Jahren. Du warst dabei, bevor es jeder war. Wenn im AI-Umfeld etwas Neues erscheint, hast du es ausprobiert, bevor andere davon gelesen haben. Egal ob Modell, Tool, Framework oder Hardware. Du baust lieber, als darüber zu reden. Du hast Berufse

We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team! We are looking for a CFD Workflow Automation Intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse. About the role: We are seeking a highly skilled intern with a strong programming background and an interest in engineering simulation to help automate repetitive CFD activities across the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager:in
jobs.description: Wer wir sind Wir sind VetTalent. Wir bringen Praxen, Kliniken und Apotheken mit den Leuten zusammen, die sie dringend suchen: Tierärzt:innen, TFAs, Ärzt:innen, MFAs und andere Fachkräfte im Gesundheitswesen. Das läuft bei uns über Kampagnen, die Menschen dort erreichen, wo sie wirklich unterwegs sind, statt über Stellenbörsen, auf denen niemand mehr sucht. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Wenn du etwas testen willst, testest du es. Was du bei uns machst Du baust und steuerst Recruiting-Kampagnen für unsere Kunden, vor allem auf Meta (Facebook und Instagram). Du findest heraus, auf welchen Kanälen wir die richtigen Bewerber noch erreichen, und testest neue. Du schaust täglich auf die Zahlen, erkennst, was läuft und was Geld verbrennt, und steuerst nach. Du testest Creatives, Texte und Zielgruppen gegeneinander, bis die Kosten pro Bewerbung stimmen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Content- und Kundenteam zusammen, damit aus guten Anzeigen gute Bewerber werden. Was du mitbringst Du kennst dich mit Meta Ads richtig gut aus: Kampagnenstruktur, Tracking, Auswertung. Du triffst Entscheidungen anhand von Daten und kannst sie auch erklären. jobs.title: Google Workspace Security Engineer (DLP and Device Management)
jobs.description: Intelance is a UK advisory and assurance firm working across enterprise architecture, cyber assurance, AI governance and data governance. We run information security management systems (ISMS) for growing technology companies certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022. We are appointing a hands on Google Workspace Security Engineer as an associate contractor to close technical security gaps for our clients. Your first assignment is with an ISO 27001 certified technology company with offices in the UK and Asia. You will set up email data loss prevention (DLP), which stops sensitive data leaving the company by email, and device management, which keeps company laptops and phones secure. The work runs from December 2026 to January 2027 and needs about 6 to 10 days in total. This is an associate panel role. Each assignment is agreed separately with a written scope, timetable and day rate. Tasks Review the client's current Google Workspace security settings and agree a short, practical plan. Design and set up Gmail DLP rules for the data that matters most, tested to avoid blocking normal work. Set up and tune device management for laptops and phones, using Google endpoint management or the client's chosen tool (for example Jamf, Kandji or Intune). Apply sensible device rules such as screen lock, disk encryption, updates and remote wipe. Check that each control works and collect clear evidence for the ISO 27001 surveillance audit. Link controls to the client's compliance platform (for example Vanta) where possible. Write short handover notes so the client's team can run the controls after you leave. Follow Intelance quality, security, confidentiality and change control procedures. Requirements Essential At least three years of hands on Google Workspace security administration in live company tenants. Has set up Gmail DLP rules in production. Has rolled out device management across macOS and mobile devices in production. Understands how these controls support ISO/IEC 27001:2022 or SOC

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description: Join GLS/NXT as a Technical Support Engineer and help keep the future of out-of-home delivery running smoothly. We’re building the OOH Platform - a smart parcel locker platform that connects carriers, locker providers, and end customers across Europe. As a Technical Support Engineer, you make sure every incident is thoroughly investigated and resolved. You handle incoming tickets, analyze logs and data to find the source of a failure, and follow each case through until it’s fully fixed. When an error keeps coming back, you push until its root cause is found and eliminated - and you build the processes, metrics, and reporting that make support predictable and transparent. If you enjoy digging into complex problems, take ownership until things are truly fixed, and thrive in a collaborative and fast-moving environment, we’d love to have you on board. Let’s build the future of logistics - together. Tasks Own incoming support tickets from triage to resolution, prioritizing by business impact. Analyze logs (e.g. Datadog) and production data (SQL) to find where an issue originates. Escalate confirmed bugs to the right team with clear, reproducible reports. Act as a technical point of contact for external partners on incidents and integration issues, requesting missing details and following up until each issue is properly resolved. Identify recurring cases and drive them to a root-cause fix instead of closing each ticket as a one-off. Build deep knowledge of the parcel lifecycle (drop-off, collection, returns, labelless flows, state transitions) and of how carrier and provider integrations behave, including edge cases. Build and improve support processes, including triage rules, escalation paths, and follow-up routines. Define and track support metrics such as ticket volume, resolution time, recurring issues, and response quality, and prepare regular reports on open issues and trends to push for long-term fixes. Requirements 3+ years of experience in technical support , app

jobs.title: Manager Service Operations & AI
jobs.description: Ben jij een ervaren IT Operations Manager die niet alleen een supportorganisatie kan aansturen, maar ook kansen ziet om dienstverlening slimmer en efficiënter te maken met AI? Dan hebben wij een interessante uitdaging voor je. Voor Fivespark, een ambitieuze Managed Service Provider in Amstelveen, zoeken wij een Manager Service Operations & AI. In deze veelzijdige functie combineer je operationeel leiderschap met procesverbetering, automatisering en de verdere ontwikkeling van een eigen AI-agent. Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid over een team van 12 supportprofessionals én speelt een belangrijke rol in de transformatie naar een steeds verder geautomatiseerde IT-dienstverlening. Over Fivespark Fivespark is een innovatieve Managed Service Provider die bedrijven en overheden ondersteunt met moderne IT-oplossingen. De organisatie werkt aan de Managed Service Provider van de toekomst, waarin automatisering, kunstmatige intelligentie en datagedreven processen een steeds grotere rol spelen. Een belangrijk onderdeel hiervan is Sparkle, een intern ontwikkelde AI-agent die nu al ondersteunt bij ticketregistratie, triage, klantvragen en routering. De ambitie is om Sparkle verder te ontwikkelen tot een volwaardige digitale collega die steeds meer operationele processen zelfstandig en betrouwbaar kan uitvoeren. De organisatie kenmerkt zich door korte lijnen, een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid. Wat ga je doen? Als Manager Service Operations & AI ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en verdere professionalisering van de tweedelijns supportorganisatie. Tegelijkertijd speel je een centrale rol in het ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI en automatisering. Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit vier belangrijke onderdelen. Leidinggeven aan de supportorganisatie Je geeft leiding aan een team van 12 tweedelijns supportmedewerkers. Je coacht en ontwikkelt medewerkers en zorgt voor duidelijke prioriteiten, structuur en samenwerking.

jobs.description: At Superchat, we re rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops. Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide , from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day . We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams. We re 100 people , profitable , and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we ve been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. If you re excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit. jobs.description: Présentation du poste : Concevoir une architecture d’IA, c’est engager une entreprise pour plusieurs années : l’emplacement des données, la gestion des accès, la manière dont un agent passe en production sous le regard des équipes de sécurité. Ces choix structurants, vous les construisez avec nos clients. Tout le reste, ce sont les ambitions fonctionnelles et techniques du client, son cadre réglementaire, son budget, les compétences qu il peut réellement mobiliser en interne, la gouvernance qu il veut installer, et un écosystème d éditeurs qui gravite autour de lui. Votre rôle est de trouver le point d équilibre entre ces forces, de le faire accepter, puis de le réajuster dès que l une d elles bouge. Votre point de départ n’est pas la technologie, mais l’ambition métier. Vous la traduisez en une plateforme data ou agentique pensée pour s’intégrer au système d’information existant, avec son histoire, ses contraintes et ses équipes. Votre rôle ne s’arrête pas à la validation du schéma cible : vous accompagnez les équipes de delivery jusqu’à la mise en production. À titre d’exemple, chez l’un de nos clients, chaque nouvel agent repose désormais sur une plateforme commune qui gère nativement les droits d’accès, le monitoring et les coûts. Chaque cas d’usage s’appuie ainsi sur les fondations posées pour les précédents. Ce poste s’adresse à vous si vous aimez embrasser un système dans son ensemble, prendre les décisions qui engagent et en expliquer les raisons. Artefact est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes entreprises mondiales pour déployer l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers : “We Make AI Work”. Notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, au cœur des métiers et à grande échelle. Et tout commence par vous.   Mission En tant qu’AI Builder Manager, vous pilotez des missions et programmes AI Adoption qui font passer l’IA de l’expérimentation à la transformation des métiers. Au contact des dirigeants et des responsables métiers, vous définissez des dispositifs de montée en compétences, de construction d’agents et d’accompagnement au changement. Vous êtes le moteur de nos missions : vous en garantissez la qualité, l’impact et la rentabilité, faites grandir vos équipes et développez vos comptes aux côtés des Directeurs et Partners. Vous partez des défis des utilisateurs métiers, de leurs processus et de leurs irritants pour transformer les possibilités de l’IA en résultats tangibles. Vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous concevez des expériences d’apprentissage engageantes, challengez et construisez des solutions IA fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et mobilisez les équipes pour faire passer ces solutions du prototype à des usages durables. Vous accompagnez les organisations dans la transformation des tâches, des rôles et responsabilités, et des compétences à l’ère de l’IA. Vous articulez les initiatives de terrain (bottom-up) avec les programmes de transformation à grande échelle (top-down), en collaboration avec nos équipes AI Strategy et Engineering. Votre ambition : faire de l’IA un levier de transformation du travail, avec un impact concret, mesurable et durable sur les équipes et leur performance.   Activités & Responsabilités I. jobs.title: Solutions Engineer - Life Sciences - EMEA
jobs.description: This role is located in Munich, Germany. TULIP is a hybrid work environment and we are in the office 3+ days/per week. About TULIP TULIP is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries. In January 2026, TULIP closed its $120M Series D , at a valuation of $1.3B. Leading global manufacturers run on TULIP, including VEKA, DMG Mori, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace and Mitsubishi Electric. We partner with NVIDIA, PwC, McKinsey, BCG and more than 160 technology partners worldwide. TULIP is part of the World Economic Forum s Global Innovator community, and our CEO, Dr. Natan Linder, co-chairs the Forum s Advanced Manufacturing Industry Governors Community.  The opportunity in DACH for TULIP DACH is the heart of global manufacturing. Germany is Europe s largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world s "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value. TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP’s headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. jobs.description: Présentation du poste : Concevoir une architecture d’IA, c’est engager une entreprise pour plusieurs années : l’emplacement des données, la gestion des accès, la manière dont un agent passe en production sous le regard des équipes de sécurité. Ces choix structurants, vous les construisez avec nos clients. Tout le reste, ce sont les ambitions fonctionnelles et techniques du client, son cadre réglementaire, son budget, les compétences qu il peut réellement mobiliser en interne, la gouvernance qu il veut installer, et un écosystème d éditeurs qui gravite autour de lui. Votre rôle est de trouver le point d équilibre entre ces forces, de le faire accepter, puis de le réajuster dès que l une d elles bouge. Votre point de départ n’est pas la technologie, mais l’ambition métier. Vous la traduisez en une plateforme data ou agentique pensée pour s’intégrer au système d’information existant, avec son histoire, ses contraintes et ses équipes. Votre rôle ne s’arrête pas à la validation du schéma cible : vous accompagnez les équipes de delivery jusqu’à la mise en production. À titre d’exemple, chez l’un de nos clients, chaque nouvel agent repose désormais sur une plateforme commune qui gère nativement les droits d’accès, le monitoring et les coûts. Chaque cas d’usage s’appuie ainsi sur les fondations posées pour les précédents. Ce poste s’adresse à vous si vous aimez embrasser un système dans son ensemble, prendre les décisions qui engagent et en expliquer les raisons. Artefact est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes entreprises mondiales pour déployer l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. jobs.description: Pilotez les missions où se jouent les paris IA des grands groupes, et transformez-les en résultats mesurables L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes. Et tout commence par vous.   Missions En tant qu’ AI Strategist Manager , vous construisez avec les dirigeants de nos clients une stratégie IA crédible, un modèle opératoire adapté et un programme de transformation qui génère une valeur mesurable. Vous êtes le moteur de nos missions AI Strategy : vous les pilotez en autonomie, en garantissez la qualité, les délais et la rentabilité, faites grandir les consultants qui y sont staffés et développez vos comptes aux côtés des Directeurs et Partners. Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier. With our core product Playtime Arcade , we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually. Architecting Intelligence to Optimize 200M+ Daily Decisions As the intelligence core of our engineering organization, our Data Science team doesn't just deploy models, we engineer the fundamental decision engine that powers our platform. At a scale of 770 million users and 100,000+ predictions per second , we are solving a multi-objective optimization problem that balances user incentives, advertiser ROI, and long-term platform health in real time. Our architecture is built on a 1PB+ behavioral data lake , providing the high-fidelity input necessary to train deep learning models that predict individual user engagement with precision. We aren't just optimizing clicks, we are dynamically calculating optimal reward structures to sustain a global value exchange. Engineered for performance, our stack leverages PyTorch for model training , NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference . We own the full ML lifecycle from high-level research and feature engineering to deployment and A/B experimentation. Here, you will find the autonomy, the data depth, and the massive scale required to solve the most complex optimization challenges in the adtech ecosystem. The data infrastructure behind this runs at real scale: 2TB ingested in real time every day , 100+ Airflow jobs and data pipelines , and ML models handling p99 latency of 100ms across 100,000+ predictions per second . It runs automated checks: tests, linting, and security and misconfiguration scans. Propose. It opens a traceable Pull Request for human review and approval. jobs.title: Head of AI
jobs.description: About Poesis Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal. About the Role Financial markets offer something rare in AI research: a continuous, objective feedback loop where you can test new ideas, measure whether they actually work, and use real-world outcomes to inform what you build next. It’s an opportunity to do frontier research with a direct line between the ideas you explore and their real-world performance. As Head of AI, you’ll lead Poesis’s AI strategy and research, setting the technical direction for how we apply frontier AI to investing. You’ll explore new AI approaches, tackle difficult research problems and help define how we use AI to better understand and predict financial markets. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll set the research agenda while continuing to work directly on technical challenges. Challenges You’ll Work On Set Poesis’s AI research direction, identify the hardest problems worth solving and guide the team's technical work. Push the capabilities of foundation models, agentic systems and world models through new architectures and research approaches. Explore pre-training, mid-training and post-training methods to improve how models learn, reason and adapt. Advance tabular ML research, including emerging methods such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs). Tackle the challenges of learning from small, high-dimensional datasets where traditional ML methods struggle. Turn promising research into models and systems that can solve difficult real-world problems. About You You’ve done exceptional AI research at a frontier

jobs.title: Sr Operations Coordinator (Day)
jobs.description: About HIVED 📦 At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing. Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery. A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better. Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market. Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures , Maersk Growth , Pale Blue Dot VC , Eka Ventures , NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery. Role Overview 📝 At HIVED, as an Operations Coordinator, you are the unique point of contact with drivers. Your role is integral to ensuring HIVED maintains drivers at the centre of our operation while maintaining high delivery performance and quality. This is an on-site role embedded in day-to-day operations. Your shift pattern will be 4 days on, 3 days off, which will require you to work one day on the weekend. jobs.title: Founding Strategy & Operations
jobs.description: Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) Founding Strategy & Operations ! Missions 🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH : ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids ; c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle. Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies. C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché , au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. Une plateforme collaborative et ouverte , connectée à l'ensemble des outils métiers des cabinets, qui fluidifie les échanges entre les gestionnaires de paie et leurs clients. Une gestion avancée des données pour offrir à plus long terme un conseil social à 360° sur l'ensemble des problématiques paie et social : budgétisation de la masse salariale, construction intelligente des grilles salariales, gestion contractuelle avancée, avantages salariés, mutuelle, etc. L'objectif : développer le « Pennylane de la paie », une plateforme centrale de gestion paie et social pour les cabinets comptables et leurs clients TPE/PME. jobs.description: At Oxa, we're building the future of Industrial Mobile Autonomy (IMA) and are in the market for new talent. Oxa’s customers are the operators of some of the world's largest industrial facilities. Our technology transforms existing industrial vehicles into intelligent autonomous fleets, unlocking new levels of productivity, safety, and performance. ‘The phone in your hand, the coffee on your desk, the shirt on your back - they all moved through a web of ports (air and sea), distribution yards and manufacturing hubs. This is the invisible circulatory system of global trade, and it relies entirely on a relentless, repetitive shuffle of goods. Towing. This towing task happens in complex, commerce-critical industrial environments. Here, having self driving technology “do the driving” delivers immediate, measurable impact. IMA will revolutionise the movement of goods across the world's ports, airports, and yards. You can be part of that as an Oxbot’ ‘Paul Newman - Founder and CEO’ Our Products: Our products are built on four core technology pillars which come together to build a complete system: Oxa Ware – Our modular autonomy hardware systems for consistent and repeatable integration of autonomy with existing vehicles. Oxa Driver – Our Physical AI, embodied in Oxa Ware, self-driving software that enables vehicles to perceive, reason, and drive autonomously in complex real-world environments. Oxa Foundry – Our development toolchain that leverages generative AI to continuously train and assure Oxa Driver, synthesising situations and sensor data. Oxa Hub – Our suite of cloud services for monitoring, managing and orchestrating fleets driven by Oxa Driver, including an API for integration with existing logistics systems. Behind these technologies is our exceptional team, the Oxbots. jobs.title: Platform Security Engineer (x/f/m)
jobs.description: Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to join the Security team at Doctolib. Your mission will be to protect sensitive healthcare data while enabling rapid, secure innovation. You will be responsible for securing Doctolib's cloud infrastructure and application ecosystem, combining multi-cloud security expertise with hands-on platform engineering — contributing directly to the safety of millions of patients and care teams who rely on our platform every day. Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. What you'll do Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Own a platform security workstream end to end, from architecture to enforcement: scope it with your tech lead, design the control, roll it out progressively (report-only, then enforce), handle exceptions, and see it through to full coverage. Typical examples: hardening IAM across our AWS accounts, tightening cluster admission policies, or closing a class of misconfiguration for good. Ship every change as code: Terraform and GitHub pull requests, peer-reviewed and always reversible. No console clicking, no undocumented state. Harden our cloud and infrastructure baseline and keep it hardened: IAM permissions and access reviews, secrets management, network and cluster guardrails, CI/CD and supply chain controls — building the guardrails and driving remediation of what they surface with platform and engineering teams, turning recurring findings into automation rather than tickets. Investigate and improve: lead incident investigations on the platform perimeter end to end, and continuously improve detection rules and response playbooks in our Elastic SIEM. Work in the open: write clear technical notes, drive adoption of your changes with the engineering teams they affect, and grow through code review and pairing with the rest of the team. La Maison est également présente via une Résidence (boutique éphémère) à Zurich depuis juillet 2024. La Maison d’une centaine de collaborateurs est aujourd’hui référente pour une clientèle francophone exigeante. Contexte de recrutement Gemmyo dispose aujourd’hui de solides actifs : Une notoriété importante sur ses marchés français, japonais, suisse et belge, et un accueil enthousiaste par ses clients Une équipe structurée autour d’un Directeur Général et de 4 pôles : Marketing, Finance & Digital, Opérations & Retail, Secrétariat Général Une compétence rare dans le domaine du luxe digital Une trésorerie confortable L’entreprise a défini un plan agressif d’expansion internationale qui sera déployé à partir de 2027. Vos missions Le service client faisant partie intégrante de notre équipe Retail, nous sommes à la recherche d’un état d’esprit, d’un enthousiasme débordant et d’une passion commune pour la joaillerie. jobs.description: Your mission About L1VE L1VE is a growing media and technology company with locations in Berlin and New York. Maintain traceability from system requirements to implementation and verification evidence. Prepare test readiness and review material, and report verification status to the FSW lead and the Chief Engineer. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. We're looking for seasoned Product Designers who thrive in ambiguity and challenging problem spaces. n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems you tackle as a designer are complex. Your design decisions must account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes impact the entire platform. To thrive here, you will need to love talking to users, understanding technology, and reducing complexity and scope. You'll be embedded in a product squad alongside a product manager and around three to five engineers, owning the user experience for your area end to end. jobs.title: Propulsion Development Engineer
jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. We want you as a talented Propulsion Development Engineer to help us in our mission by supporting in the development, manufacturing and testing of the Nyx Earth Propulsion systems. In order to qualify the propulsion systems a multitude of tests will be required spanning from functional tests, cold flows to system level hotfires. This testing will allow for the verification and validation of all the propulsion subsystems. You will be designing test rigs to validate flight design, assembling and lastly performing the testing on the test rigs to provide critical data needed to validate simulation models. You will report to the Propulsion Development Models Principal Engineer. Key responsibilities : In your capacity as a Propulsion Development Engineer, you will be responsible for the on-time and on-cost design, development and testing activities linked to the propulsion sub-systems. Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include: During the Design Phase; Define and maintain the test objectives and requirements Establish and justify, together with the pressure and fluidic system engineers, the architecture and the design (P&ID, PBS, interfaces) of the models and test rigs Design of thruster test rigs Define and select components, parts and sensors and manage their procurement Elaborate and maintain the schedule and cost, ensuring on-time and on-cost of the pressure system and the propellant feed system test rigs. Create test procedures ensuring safe and efficient operation of all test rigs During assembly and testing phase Support on the testing and assembly of thrusters Perform assembly, troubleshooting and commissioning of the test rigs Perform test campaigns, analyzing in real-time the test parameters and the test results with timely resolution of any anomaly arising during testing. jobs.title: Senior AI Implementation Engineer (x/f/m)

Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für unsere komplexesten Implementierungen des KI-basierten Telefonassistenten und stellst sicher, dass Praxen und Krankenhäuser ein effizientes, zuverlässiges und nachhaltiges Onboarding-Erlebnis haben. Als technischer Sparring Partner im Team entwickelst Du Standards, Prozesse und Lösungen, die unser Onboarding skalierbarer machen – und wirkst mit Deinen Verbesserungen weit über den eigenen Bereich hinaus. Deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst technisch anspruchsvolle Installationen und Konfigurationen des KI-gestützten Telefon Assistenten bei Key Accounts – inklusive komplexer Telefonanlagen und Eskalationsfälle, und sorgst so für eine konsistent gute Onboarding-Journey unserer Kund:innen. Du treibst unsere Multi-Onboarding-Strategie voran und verantwortest mittelfristig auch das Onboarding unseres Kalenders und unserer All-in-One Praxissoftware – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Technical Onboarding Teams. Stakeholder Management: Du bist die primäre technische Ansprechperson für Key Accounts, deren IT sowie für Key Account Manager:innen und pflegst aktiv die Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern aus Sales, Deployment und Product. Wissenstransfer & Coaching: Du coachst Kolleg:innen, teilst Dein Know-how proaktiv und definierst Best Practices, Playbooks und Trainingsmaterialien – für ein höheres technisches Niveau und mehr Konsistenz im gesamten Team. Projektmanagement: Du initiierst und leitest eigenständig cross-funktionale Projekte zur Prozessverbesserung und treibst den gezielten Einsatz von KI-Tools voran, um repetitive Aufgaben zu automatisieren und Kapazitäten für das Wesentliche freizusetzen: unsere Kund:innen und ihre Patient:innen. Du nutzt operative Daten und Kundenfeedback, um Verbesserungen in Produkt und Prozess voranzutreiben – z. B. in Feedback

jobs.description: Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung Mitteldeutschland zählt zu den wichtigsten Gesundheitsregionen Deutschlands – und zu den Märkten, die Digitalisierung am dringendsten brauchen. Wir bei Doctolib machen diesen Wandel möglich: mit einer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung, die Healthcare Professionals entlastet und Patient:innen bessere Versorgung bringt – Praxis für Praxis. Als Sales Manager SaaS / B2B (x/f/m) führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business: von der strategischen Marktbearbeitung bis zum kontinuierlichen Umsatzwachstum. Deine Mission: Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams in Thüringen und Sachsen für Doctolib zu begeistern, nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum voranzutreiben und Deine Region zu einem der stärksten Märkte Deutschlands zu entwickeln. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben. Deine Aufgaben Territory Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Du trägst die vollständige Verantwortung für Dein Vertriebsgebiet – von der Marktanalyse über gezielte Akquise bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Du entscheidest, wie Du Deine Energie einsetzt, um maximalen Impact zu erzielen. Nachhaltiges Umsatz- und Pipelinewachstum: Du verantwortest Deinen Erfolg, Deine Pipeline und Dein Netzwerk in der Region – und Du weißt, wie Du alle drei systematisch aufbaust und konsequent entwickelst. Stärke im Neukundengeschäft: Du verstehst, was Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams bewegt – und machst dieses Verständnis zu Deinem stärksten Argument. Du akquirierst zielgerichtet, pitchst mit Überzeugung und bringst Deals konsequent zum Abschluss. Datengetriebene Vertriebssteuerung: Du misst Deine Performance konsequent mit Salesforce, analysierst Deine Kennzahlen, erkennst Muster früh und steuerst gezielt nach. Dein Profil Wenn Du nicht jeden der folgenden Punkte erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass diese Stelle zu Dir passt – bewirb Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Perspektive! Nachgewiesene Stärke im Digital Health Sales: Du bringst solide Vertriebser

jobs.description: Medical Data Intern (x/f/m) Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Medical Data Intern to join the Terminology and Ontology team within the Medical Excellence department at Doctolib in Berlin . At Doctolib, we're setting a new pulse for healthcare. We create AI-powered solutions that help health professionals focus on care and help people prevent, detect, and treat health problems earlier. In this role, you will contribute to making medical information clear, structured, and usable across products for patients, healthcare professionals, and technical teams. What you'll do Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Collect and format sets of terms describing pathologies, allergies, treatments, and other medical concepts, based on standard medical terminologies such as ICD-10 and SNOMED CT. Adapt medical labels to create versions that are understandable to patients and healthcare professionals. Translate labels from English into German. Map medical lists of terms across different products. Select and filter terms, then validate your choices with medical experts. Share your work and methodology with the Terminology and Ontology team and product teams. Deliver sets of terms to technical teams in the correct format. About our data environment Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to the country and healthcare specialty requirements. Our stack is composed of Dagster, dbt, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, and other technologies. We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here and learn about our first AI hackathon here ! If you would like to find out more about tech life at Doctolib, feel free to read our latest Medium blog articles ! jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: De IT-afdeling van Den Hartogh (25 collega's) werkt als één team aan de groei en doelstellingen van ons familiebedrijf, verdeeld over clusters als IT Operations, Architecture & Security en Data Integration & Analytics. Als Data Engineer binnen dat laatste cluster help je de business proactief bij het behalen van haar zakelijke en financiële doelen, met data in de breedste zin van het woord. Via applicaties, dashboarding en ad-hocanalyses moderniseer je ons datalandschap, en er is volop ruimte om te innoveren met predictive & generative AI, Data Science en Process Automation (RPA) . Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Teamlead Data Integration & Analytics. Wat ga je doen? Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety. Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering. We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment. jobs.description: Are you passionate about data, technology and sustainability? ONE-Dyas is looking for a Production & ESG Data Engineer to ensure the accurate collection, administration and reporting of production, hydrocarbon and ESG data. You will turn complex data into reliable insights that support operational and business decisions. Meet ONE-Dyas ONE-Dyas B.V. is the largest privately owned exploration and production company in the Netherlands. As entrepreneurs in Dutch offshore gas and oil, the company aims to make a significant contribution to the energy transition, working at the forefront of sustainability and technological innovation. Extracting gas and oil close to home contributes to the national economy, security of supply, and climate goals by employing local services, products, and know-how, reducing the reliance on imported fuels, cutting emissions, and complying to the highest environmental standards in the industry. jobs.description: Company Driver Job Overview: We are looking for a dependable Logistics Company Driver to ensure the safe, timely, and accurate delivery of goods to various locations. You will be responsible for operating company vehicles, maintaining their roadworthiness, and representing the company with professionalism on the road. Key Responsibilities: Safely transport and deliver goods to designated clients and locations within Metro Manila and nearby provinces. Plan and navigate the most efficient delivery routes to ensure on-time performance. Conduct routine pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections. Perform basic mechanical and electrical troubleshooting, and immediately report major vehicle issues. Secure cargo properly and assist with loading and unloading as required. Maintain accurate delivery logs, route records, and vehicle maintenance reports. Communicate effectively with the dispatch team regarding delivery status, traffic delays, or route changes. Qualifications: Valid Professional Driver's License: Must possess Restriction Codes A, A1, B, B1, and B2. Experience: 2-3 years of proven driving and delivery experience within the limits of your license restriction codes. Technical Skills: Basic knowledge of vehicle troubleshooting (mechanical and electrical). A TESDA NC2 certificate is a strong advantage. Navigation: Extensive familiarity with Metro Manila routes, as well as nearby provinces. Character: Excellent driving record, good moral character, and strong communication skills. Flexibility: Highly adaptable with the ability to multitask, work shifting schedules (Day, Mid, Night), and take days off on a rotating basis. Location: Willing to be assigned to Elisco Rd., Ibayo Tipas, Taguig City. Availability: Can start immediately. How to Apply: Please submit your updated resume/CV through Kalibrr. Applications without an attached resume will not be considered.

jobs.title: Stage Bouw
jobs.description: Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor! Dit wordt jouw stage Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is! Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer

Wij richten ons op het creëren en delen van de beste voetbalcontent op alle platformen wereldwijd. Onze enorme fanbase bevat meer dan 15.000 professionele voetballers, waaronder Cristiano Ronaldo, Kylian Mbappé en Erling Haaland. En we zijn meer dan alleen social media: met de 433-app brengen we alles samen op één plek. Daarnaast help je mee om de app elke dag te vullen met de beste content: van nieuwsupdates en transfers tot quizzen en Predictions rondom de grootste wedstrijden. Je bent altijd op zoek naar nieuws, doelpunten, transfers, skills, e-sports en nog veel meer. Jij leeft voor voetbal, net zoals wij. Met jouw creativiteit en out-of-the-box mindset bedenk je nieuwe concepten om miljoenen volgers en app-gebruikers te betrekken. jobs.title: Senior Scrum master
jobs.description: Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken. AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter. Daarvoor heb je iemand nodig die mensen verbindt, samenwerking versterkt en verandering écht in beweging krijgt. Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We bouwen aan moderne software, slimme dataplatformen en agentic oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd kijken we hoe AI onze eigen manier van werken verandert. Daarom zoeken we een Scrum Master die verder kijkt dan Scrum events. Iemand die begrijpt dat Agile niet allen draait om ceremonies, maar ook om waarde toevoegen, wendbaarheid, eigenaarschap en samenwerking. Jouw rol Als Scrum Master begeleid je multidisciplinaire teams die werken aan complexe softwareprojecten, data-oplossingen en AI-first applicaties. Je helpt teams om beter samen te werken, obstakels weg te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor de organisatie, developers, product owners en stakeholders en weet wanneer je moet coachen, uitdagen of juist ruimte moet geven. Maar je kijkt ook vooruit. Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? En hoe zorg je dat teams nieuwe technologie omarmen zonder hun focus op mensen en resultaat te verliezen? Je hoeft niet zelf te programmeren, maar je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en begrijpt hoe veranderingen in software engineering invloed en impact hebben op de organisatie, teams en processen. Wat ga je doen? Coachen van Agile-teams op focus, samenwerking, communicatie en voorspelbaarheid Faciliteren van Scrum-events die daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan verbetering Signaleren en wegnemen van blokkades binnen teams en binnen de organisatie Versterken van de samenwerking tussen developers, product owners, business en stakeholders. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. Wie ben jij Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten. Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. jobs.title: Senior Partnership Manager Payments
jobs.description: Opleiding: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur met een achtergrond in bedrijfskunde, economie, finance, commerciële economie of vergelijkbaar. Ervaring: Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships of business development. Kennis: Van card schemes, issuing, acquiring en de werking van het internationale betalingsverkeer. Persoonlijkheid: Je bent communicatief sterk, organisatiesensitief, zelfstandig en overtuigend op senior niveau. Salaris: € 7.000,- en € 8.000,- p/m. WAT GA JE DOEN? Elke dag checken 6,5 miljoen Nederlanders in om te reizen met het OV. Met de OV-chipkaart, OV-pas, betaalpas, creditcard of mobiel. En dat werkt simpel en soepel. Kaart voor de lezer en … ‘bliep’. Reizen maar! Maar achter die ‘bliep’ gaat een complexe wereld schuil. Welkom in de wereld van Translink! Met de introductie van nieuwe betaalmogelijkheden onder de vlag OVpay is Translink dichter komen te staan bij de bredere financiële sector. In- en uitchecken met de bankpas vereist goede afstemming met banken. Maar ook de bredere inzet van EMV-technologie met OVpay maakt dat we als bedrijf te maken hebben met bestaande card schemes. Als Senior Partnership Manager Payments - Card Schemes & Banken, ben jij het externe gezicht van Translink binnen het paymentecosysteem. Je onderhoudt strategische relaties met onder andere Visa, Mastercard, banken en andere belangrijke partijen in het betalingsverkeer. Je begrijpt hun belangen en ontwikkelingen en weet deze te verbinden met de ambities van Translink en OVpay. Je beweegt je gemakkelijk op senior niveau en voert gesprekken met zowel inhoudelijke experts als directies en bestuurders. Daarbij begrijp je niet alleen de commerciële kant van partnerships, maar ook hoe de paymentketen inhoudelijk werkt. Je weet wat ontwikkelingen binnen issuing, acquiring en card schemes betekenen voor Translink en kunt deze vertalen naar concrete keuzes en afspraken. Intern werk je nauw samen met onder ander

Setelah sanggup memenuhi pasar Indonesia, Perseroan melakukan Penawaran Umum Perdana dan menjadi perusahaan publik pada tahun 1990 dengan target market; konsumen Asean. jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Payments Team
jobs.description: Join a fast-growing, listed company with a purpose! Fastned owns and operates a network of 400+ fast charging stations across 10 European countries, allowing electric vehicle drivers to charge their car with 100% green energy in just 15 minutes. Our goal is a European network of 1000 fast charging stations in prime locations, where all electric vehicles can charge with renewable energy from the sun and wind. We have recently been voted best charging network in the UK, France and the Netherlands. If you want to make a difference and work in an informal, international scale-up environment with future prospects, then read on! Your role Fastned aims to accelerate the transition towards sustainable mobility by giving fast charging to electric drivers. Part of that mission is making car charging as simple as charging your phone, and paying for it should be just as effortless. As a Backend Engineer in the Payments team, you will help make paying for a charge frictionless, secure and reliable. Drivers can pay through the Fastned app, by QR code or with a contactless card at the charger. The team owns Fastned’s payments domain end to end. That covers integrations with payment service providers and payment terminals. It also covers the services behind payment methods, wallets, pre-authorisation and session payments, billing, invoicing and dunning. The stakes are high: Fastned handles 23,000+ charging sessions a day, and every one of those payments goes through our systems. We’re now moving towards real-time payments, where each session is paid instantly instead of invoiced later. As we are growing and adding roaming features as a Mobility Service Provider, there are many scale relevant challenges to solve. We have no legacy systems. You’ll work with Kotlin 2.x, Java 21+, and Spring Boot 4 on most services, AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, SQL (Postgres), Terraform, GitLab CI/CD and REST APIs to build scalable, fault-tolerant services that drivers and our Finance team rely on every day

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent

Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers. As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. jobs.description: QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢. The Role We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality. You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to. Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer. We are a remote team spread across time zones.
